notablePrerequisites: There are at least five creature cards in all graveyards.
description:
Activate Drakestown Forgotten by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Drakestown Forgotten enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
When Drakestown Forgotten enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Drakestown Forgotten.
Activate Drakestown Forgotten using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
